rationale: Merge the separately modeled BTR Jet Center child record into Velocity FBO Network, the sole Tallvine-owned manager-level platform. Velocity completed the add-on in February 2026, the Baton Rouge airport assigned the operating and hangar leases to Velocity BTR Holdings, LLC, and the location now operates as Velocity Baton Rouge (KBTR). Preserve the child's operating and transaction history as platform milestones and aliases, create the durable production redirect, and exclude BTR Air Charter because no acquisition evidence was found.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Velocity FBO Network is Tallvine's U.S. fixed-base-operator platform, assembled from Odyssey Aviation's U.S. assets and expanded through add-on acquisitions. The network provides aircraft fueling, hangar, ground-handling and related business-aviation services across multiple U.S. airports. In February 2026, Velocity acquired BTR Jet Center after Baton Rouge approved assignment of the operating and hangar leases to Velocity BTR Holdings, LLC; the location now operates as Velocity Baton Rouge (KBTR). BTR Air Charter remains outside the platform perimeter because no evidence established that it was acquired.
